evaluation_contract.hyperparameters: Each version uses its original-grid validation-selected lambda; validation has been used for development.
evaluation_contract.target: Detector-derived next-seven-day military-action report proxy, not independently verified events.
evaluation_contract.comparison_limit: Compare common windows with both fixed label definitions; native windows/targets may change. Small dependent samples do not establish significance or generalization.

common_windows.note: Both model comparisons use the same anchors and target labels within each matrix. Constant and persistence baselines are version-specific: own training rate and own detected historical action. Neither label definition is independent truth.

limitations: Agreement is with GPT-6 Astra model-generated labels, not human gold or independently verified events.

All five labels of a record are excluded if any label is uncertain, either annotation round disagrees, a model quality flag exists, or prior source/scope quarantine applies. Exclusions never become negative labels.
These development cases can inform repairs; reuse for post-repair scoring is a diagnostic, not an untouched holdout.
Media and case groups are small and dependent. No statistical significance or population generalization is inferred.
Article-level agreement does not measure future seven-day event forecast accuracy.
